summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests TROP2 CAR-NK cells, which are natural killer immune cells made from cord blood and engineered to target TROP2, in adults with advanced solid tumors. The cells are given by vein (IV) at one of up to 5 dose levels, after lymphodepleting chemotherapy with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide, and how long or how often treatment lasts is not stated. The study's main goal is to find the recommended dose of TROP2-CAR-NK cells; other outcome measures are not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células NK con receptor CAR dirigido a TROP2, que son células inmunitarias naturales asesinas obtenidas de sangre de cordón y modificadas para atacar TROP2, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. Las células se administran por vena (IV) en uno de hasta 5 niveles de dosis, después de quimioterapia de linfodepleción con fludarabina y ciclofosfamida; la duración o la frecuencia del tratamiento no se indican. El objetivo principal del estudio es encontrar la dosis recomendada de las células NK con CAR-TROP2; no se indican otras medidas de resultado.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid tumor that progressed after standard treatment, or with no standard treatment available (dose escalation).
Tumor TROP2 expression of 2+ or 3+ by IHC test.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Prior CAR T, NK, or other genetically modified T or NK cell therapy.
Known HIV infection or active or chronic hepatitis B or C.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
